RPU Wave 7 STRATEGIZE (2026-07-16): close the last render-unification parity HOLE — the 3 studio-chat interactive cards in @barkpark/react

Status: REVIEWED + GREEN (grade A−, 2026-07-16). (Superseded the interim SURVEYING status — the full story runs Strategize → Decide → REVIEW debrief at the foot.) This Paper is the wave's living story. Strategize opened it; Digest appends the survey digest + verify plan; Decide appends decisions + the build plan; Review closes it as the debrief. Someone opening it mid-wave sees exactly where the wave stands.

The wish (verbatim intent)

The canonical JS renderer @barkpark/react does NOT render 3 block types that BOTH proven parity twins already render. Go (internal/pdrender/chat_blocks.go + pdrender.go:387-389) and Elixir (compose.ex:992-1000 → components.ex:874/894/918) both dispatch chat-approval, chat-plan, chat-question — the studio-chat interactive cards. @barkpark/react has ZERO dispatch for them (its src/blocks/chat.ts registers only the 3 inert siblings). The ONE canonical renderer is therefore INCOMPLETE, and scripts/pd-parity-completeness.sh reds on main (in-scope count 45; goldens missing for exactly these 3). Their 3 siblings chat-thinking/chat-todo/chat-tool-diff are already rendered in all 3 surfaces with committed goldens — mirror that exact treatment. Deliverables: (1) implement the 3 render clauses in @barkpark/react matching Go+Elixir output shape; (2) seed goldens in BOTH api/test/support/fixtures/pd-parity/ and js/packages/react/tests/fixtures/pd-golden/; (3) make bash scripts/pd-parity-completeness.sh exit 0; (4) prove parity across all 3 surfaces, each proof protective (fails on revert). This unblocks rpu-backlog-field-embed-coverage.

Ground truth — confirmed at Strategize (not assumed)

Surfacechat-approval / chat-question / chat-plan?Evidence
Go / pdrenderYES — all 3pdrender.go:387-389 registers chatApproval/Question/Plan; chat_blocks.go:255 "the INTERACTIVE cards"; chat_golden_toolrows.json carries all 6
Elixir / :articleYES — all 3compose.ex:992-1000 dispatch heads; components.ex:874/894/918 emit <div class="bp-chat-approval text-xs" style="font-family: var(--font-mono);"> etc; builders at L731-780
JS / @barkpark/reactNO — the HOLEsrc/blocks/chat.ts:261-263 map registers only chat-tool-diff / chat-todo / chat-thinking; unknown types degrade to bp-unknown-block

Both fixture dirs currently hold exactly 42 goldens (byte-identical mirrors). The sibling golden format: {_comment, expectedHtml (frozen :article HTML), input, shape (DOM projection), type}. The completeness script hardcodes EXPECTED_COUNT=42 and greps compose.ex in-scope types (now 45) → it fails on BOTH the count (45≠42) AND the 3 missing goldens.

Direction — this is a FROZEN-SET GROWTH event, not "add 3 files"

The trap: the 42-type pd-golden set is FROZEN, and many downstream consumers hardcode 42 or enumerate the exact type list. Growing it to 45 must be done coherently across every mirror, every count guard, every seed, and the gen-task source-of-truth — or half the JS suite reds. The finished experience: bash scripts/pd-parity-completeness.sh exits 0, the JS parity proof asserts 45/45 shape-equal (auto-extended via its readdirSync glob), and reverting any one new chat.ts clause reds the proof (degrades to bp-unknown-block). The 3 cards look/read identically in Studio, bp chat, and a Phoenix-faithful blog — closing the epic's thesis that the ONE canonical renderer renders EVERYTHING the twins do.

The ripple map (the real risk surface — every 42-hardcoder that must move to 45)

  • scripts/pd-parity-completeness.sh — EXPECTED_COUNT=42 → 45
  • api/lib/mix/tasks/barkpark.portable_doc.gen_pd_parity.ex — the @inputs 42-map (source of truth); add 3 inputs so a future regen stays coherent even though we hand-author goldens (mix OOMs on this host)
  • Any api ExUnit test asserting the excluded-set / count equality against the bash guard
  • js/.../react/tests/PortableDoc.parity.test.tsx — globs the dir → AUTO-extends to 45 (protective by construction)
  • js/.../react/tests/toPlainText.typekeyed.test.ts + tests/fixtures/pd-plaintext-golden.ts — W6's partition "covers ALL 42 exactly once"; a NEW type surfaces and FAILS until it gets a PROSE_GOLDEN or TEXTLESS_SKIP entry
  • js/.../create-barkpark-app — showcase-content.ts seed (auto-generated from pd-golden) + showcase-content.test.ts (42-fingerprint assert) → 45
  • js/.../next-parity, js/.../astro-parity, js/.../media-parity, blog-hydration-parity — check each ≥42 vs exact-42 count guard

Tentative leanings (Decide finalizes after two explore rounds)

  • Author the 3 JS emitters in chat.ts as string-HTML functions mirroring the existing sibling pattern, registered in the chatBlocks map. The AUTHORITATIVE target markup is what components.ex emits at :article (L874-935) — byte-for-byte the golden's expectedHtml.
  • Hand-author the 3 goldens (both mirrors, byte-identical) by extracting the exact Elixir emitter output — do NOT force the OOM-prone mix task. But STILL add the 3 to the gen-task @inputs so the source of truth reflects 45.
  • Input fixtures must match real block field names from the components.ex builders (approval: tool/params; question: prompt/options; plan: title/steps) — surveyors extract these.
  • Grow 42→45 everywhere in one coherent slice-set; the chat cards are almost-certainly TEXTLESS in toPlainText (match sibling treatment) → SKIP allow-list, not PROSE_GOLDEN — verify against how the siblings are partitioned.
  • Wire the completeness guard into CI (the pre-filed task's 2nd criterion) — lean YES, it is cheap governance and half the pre-filed task; touches .github/ only.
  • Anti-vacuous: the parity proof reds on revert by construction (unknown → bp-unknown-block); confirm no test silently skips the 3.

Tasks this wave drives

  • rpu-backlog-completeness-guard-chat-types — the pre-filed task; both criteria (reconcile 3 goldens + wire guard into CI). THIS is the wave's spine.
  • Unblocks rpu-backlog-field-embed-coverage — flips its prerequisite criterion (guard green at true in-scope count).

Hard constraints (lead notes)

  • PRIMARY code = JS @barkpark/react (3 render clauses) + goldens in BOTH fixture dirs. compose.ex/chat_blocks.go/components.ex are READ-ONLY REFERENCE — study output shape, do NOT edit renderer logic.
  • api/ test-fixture changes make the Elixir Test gate RELEVANT — wait for it. Sobelow stale-baseline reds are EXPECTED noise. A @barkpark/react change REQUIRES a changeset.
  • mix gen_pd_parity MAY OOM — hand-author goldens matching an existing chat-* sibling byte-format if so; never boot a full server.
  • Verify concretely: bash scripts/pd-parity-completeness.sh exits 0. Parity proof FAILS if the new clause is reverted.
  • DO-NOT-TOUCH: the 42 existing goldens (ADD alongside), the 14 field/embed excluded types, unrelated compose.ex dispatch, foreign template trees, connectors.
  • All Opus (Fable exhausted). Builders commit to LOCAL worktree branches off origin/main; steward pushes+PRs; main checkout stays on main.

Survey plan (in flight now — broad Sonnet scouts)

Width is cheap here; Digest distills. Each assignment names suspected files + claims to check. See the StructuredOutput survey list for the full set of questions and why each changes the plan.

DIGEST (2026-07-16) — survey folded, verify fleet in flight

15 survey reports distilled. The wave is now verifying: 7 targeted assignments fly to PROVE the load-bearing claims (real emitter bytes, Elixir gate green, toPlainText partition, anti-vacuous-green) before Decide cuts the plan.

What the survey ESTABLISHED

  • The hole is real & precise, confirmed live. bash scripts/pd-parity-completeness.sh reds on main: in-scope count: 45, on-disk goldens 42, FAIL: no golden fixture for in-scope type(s): chat-approval chat-plan chat-question. compose.ex dispatches all 45; @barkpark/react chatEmitters (chat.ts:260-264 — the map is chatEmitters, NOT "chatBlocks" as the strategy note said) registers only the 3 inert siblings.
  • Target count is 45, NOT 46 — but watch #3670. PR #3670 (gauge-list web/email twin) is still OPEN/unmerged; gauge-list is absent from main compose.ex. If #3670 merges before this wave, the target becomes 46 AND gauge-list needs its own golden. The steward MUST re-check #3670 merge state before hardcoding EXPECTED_COUNT.
  • Emitter contract mapped (two layers). Emitters read the SYNTHESIZED BLOCK (Layer B), NOT the raw persisted meta: chat-approval {tool_name, summary, approval_status}; chat-question {questions:[{question, options:[bare strings]}], approval_status}; chat-plan {title, preview, approval_status}. The golden input carries this built-block shape. Go + Elixir read identical fields.
  • ONE divergence to mirror carefully: approval title default. Elixir uses status === "pending" → "Allow X?"; Go uses pending||empty. The JS clause MUST mirror Elixir (byte-authoritative for the :article golden). All fixtures use "pending", so the edge isn't exercised — but the clause must be Elixir-faithful.
  • Golden byte-format nailed. jq -S output (keys sorted every level, 2-space, one trailing newline); top keys _comment/expectedHtml/input/shape/type; _comment verbatim across all goldens; shape[] classes are SORTED alphabetically (a class-SET, not HTML order — a common comparator trap); shape text is HTML-entity-decoded; the two mirror dirs are byte-identical. Recipe: build object → pipe jq -S → write BOTH dirs.
  • Anti-vacuous-green holds BY CONSTRUCTION — with a caveat. Unregistered type → registry.ts:43 bp-unknown-block → shape mismatch vs real golden → assertShapeEqual throws. BUT the JS proof globs the JS pd-golden dir with only a >=42 FLOOR, so a golden seeded ONLY api-side is vacuously untested on the JS side. "Seed BOTH mirrors" is load-bearing for the protective property, not just symmetry.
  • Changeset required. @barkpark/react is public (no private field, not in changeset ignore) → minor bump, mirror js/.changeset/react-toplaintext-typekeyed.md. Size headroom is UNMEASURED (dist is stale) — must run pnpm build && pnpm size; budget-bump fallback precedent exists.
  • CSS untouched. paper-surface.css has zero .bp-chat* selectors; the D6 tokens already cover the new cards (they use only --font-mono + --border-muted). Mirror siblings, leave CSS alone.

The 42→45 ripple — coherent slice-set

HARD BREAK (must touch, reds until moved):

  • scripts/pd-parity-completeness.sh:22 — EXPECTED_COUNT 42→45
  • api/test/barkpark/portable_doc/render/pd_golden_parity_test.exs:35 — assert ==42→45, PLUS the freshness lock: goldens MUST byte-equal GenPdParity.build/1 output, and the two mirror dirs MUST be term-identical (per-type mirror-identity test)
  • api/lib/mix/tasks/barkpark.portable_doc.gen_pd_parity.ex — add 3 @inputs entries (types() derives the count from keys; do NOT touch the fixture-DATA "42"s at L176/242/265/308)
  • js/.../toPlainText.typekeyed.test.ts (cases 42→45, textless 24→27) + pd-plaintext-golden.ts (3 TEXTLESS_SKIP entries, each with non-empty rationale)
  • create-barkpark-app/tests/showcase-content.test.ts (3 hard ==42 assertions at L61/65/98) + regenerate the auto-gen seed via node scripts/gen-showcase-content.mjs (order: goldens → regen seed → bump counts)

AUTO-EXTEND (self-healing, become downstream protective proofs, no count edit): PortableDoc.parity.test.tsx (readdirSync glob; only a >=42 FLOOR + cosmetic CHAT_TYPES/describe title), next-parity, astro-parity (glob the dir; per-golden shape loop auto-asserts the 3 new → they red if @barkpark/react doesn't actually render them).

INERT to +3: blog-hydration-parity, media-parity (no count, direct-path imports), paper-surface.css.

Contradictions / tensions the verifiers resolve

  • toPlainText: TEXTLESS_SKIP vs PROSE_GOLDEN. The toplaintext surveyor READ toPlainText.ts — no switch case for the 3 types → default→'' exactly like the 3 siblings (all TEXTLESS_SKIP). The Go surveyor flagged the Go PROJECTION carries extractable prose → suggested PROSE. Resolution: Go's projection is a DIFFERENT system; JS source returns '' → SKIP is correct AND matches the wish's "mirror sibling treatment." Verifier proves it by running the test.
  • gen task runnability. The gen-task surveyor argues build/1 is pure (no boot/Repo) and the freshness test already runs it in the Elixir CI env → recommends RUNNING the mix task. Lead notes + wish warn it MAY OOM on this host. Biggest build-phase risk — verifier #1 settles it by attempting the render and capturing ground-truth bytes either way.

Coverage map — checked & FOUND

compose.ex dispatch; components.ex emitters + builders + helpers + util escape; gen_pd_parity task; pd_golden_parity_test (freshness + count); completeness script (run live); chat.ts sibling emitters + chatEmitters map; registry DISPATCH + bp-unknown-block fallback; PortableDoc.parity.test glob + comparator wiring; toPlainText.ts + partition test + golden; create-barkpark-app showcase test + gen script; next/astro/blog-hydration/media parity; paper-surface.css; changeset config + size budgets + W6 changeset; Go pdrender.go + chat_blocks.go + testdata; golden byte-format (mirror dirs byte-identical).

Coverage map — checked & NOT FOUND (decisions in waiting)

  • No surveyor RAN the gen task or extracted real emitter bytes — all read-only. The freshness lock's ground truth (the exact expectedHtml bytes) is UNVERIFIED. The elixir-emitter-bytes markup is hand-derived, not proven.
  • dom-shape.ts BODY not read — whether the comparator normalizes class-set order-insensitively (forgiving) or trusts golden order (load-bearing) is unresolved.
  • @barkpark/react green baseline never RUN — the "42 parity + toPlainText 42 pass today" claims come from reading, not execution (distrust vacuous green).
  • create-barkpark-app drift check — whether the showcase test has a byte-diff drift check beyond the 3 count assertions is unconfirmed.
  • next/astro-parity CI build path — whether their CI actually runs next/astro build before vitest (else stale container counts) is unconfirmed.
  • CI wiring — doc-gates.yml insertion point confirmed by reading only, not a dry workflow run.
  • bp ledger prior-art — surveyors couldn't search (wrong verb); the two driving tasks are confirmed to exist (spine rpu-backlog-completeness-guard-chat-types open/2 criteria unmet; rpu-backlog-field-embed-coverage blocked on the spine).

Corners no surveyor reached: the live behavior of the mix gen task on THIS host; the dom-shape comparator internals; the actual @barkpark/react test-suite green baseline; CI workflow execution for the new guard step.

What Decide cannot live without

  1. The exact ground-truth :article HTML bytes for the 3 cards (freshness test byte-equals build/1) — must RUN the render path.
  2. Proof the Elixir gate goes GREEN with goldens + count bumps (freshness + mirror-identity + count + completeness script).
  3. toPlainText partition proven by EXECUTION (SKIP, not PROSE).
  4. #3670 merge state at build time (45 vs 46 + gauge-list golden).
  5. Real @barkpark/react size headroom for the changeset decision.

W7 DECIDE (2026-07-16) — verification results, decisions, wave plan

The deep verify fleet (6 assignments, run-proofs) settled every open unknown. The wish's premise is confirmed exactly: @barkpark/react renders ZERO of the 3 studio-chat interactive cards that both twins render, and bash scripts/pd-parity-completeness.sh is RED on main (in-scope 45, goldens 42). Target count is 45, not 46 — gauge-list (PR #3670) is still OPEN/unmerged.

Decisions (D39–D46 — mirror the charter)

  • D39 — Target 45, not 46; gauge-list (#3670) is a watch-item → rpu-backlog-gauge-list-golden. Re-check #3670 before merge.
  • D40 — RUN the mix gen task (no OOM; pure build/1; writes both mirrors); do NOT hand-author goldens (freshness lock byte-equals build/1).
  • D41 — 3 emitters read the synthesized block, mirror components.ex :article byte-for-byte; approval title = Elixir pending-branch (not Go); handle status + empty-set branches; register in chatEmitters.
  • D42 — 3 cards are TEXTLESS → TEXTLESS_SKIP (proven by running toPlainText), not PROSE_GOLDEN.
  • D43 — 42→45 reds 5 hard-break guards (completeness script, pd_golden_parity_test, toPlainText partition, PortableDoc.test.tsx CASES, gen @inputs) + create-barkpark-app — all move this wave.
  • D44 — Anti-vacuous holds by construction; seed BOTH mirrors (JS mirror is load-bearing for revert-red); build before test.
  • D45 — CI-wire the guard into doc-gates.yml (rides Slice 1); minor react changeset + patch cba changeset; size gate.
  • D46 — 2 slices, both Opus: Slice 1 the coupled vertical (one PR), Slice 2 create-barkpark-app regen SEQUENCED on Slice 1's branch; lead merges both in one cycle.

Wave plan — 2 slices (both Opus; Fable exhausted; worktrees off origin/main; commit locally, no push)

REVIEW — DEBRIEF (2026-07-16): REVIEWED + GREEN, grade A−

The last render-unification parity HOLE is CLOSED. The one canonical JS renderer @barkpark/react now renders every in-scope block type its Elixir + Go twins dispatch. bash scripts/pd-parity-completeness.sh is GREEN on the reviewer branch — "OK: all 46 in-scope", exit 0.

What shipped (1 built slice + reviewer absorption)

  • rpu-backlog-completeness-guard-chat-types → final branch loop-epic/render-chat-approval-chat-plan-chat-ques-0-r. The 3 studio-chat cards (chat-approval/chat-question/chat-plan) implemented in src/blocks/chat.ts as byte-faithful twins of components.ex chat_approval_html/1·chat_question_html/1·chat_plan_html/1 at :article — verified line-by-line (shared chatCardHeader/chatCardBody/chatStatusLabel/chatQuestionItem, the pending "Allow <tool>?" title branch, empty question-set + empty-options fallbacks, and the == null guard that reproduces Elixir's Map.get default-fires-on-absent-key-only semantics). Escalation handled correctly: #3670 (gauge-list) had already landed on the base, so the in-scope count is 46, not the brief's 45 — the builder detected this via the criterion-7 clause, added a faithful gauge-list twin of data_viz.ex gauge_list_html/1 (share + count + the unbacked epic sentinel) plus its golden, and bumped every 42→46 count guard. Goldens seeded in BOTH mirrors via the real mix barkpark.portable_doc.gen_pd_parity (not hand-authored), byte-identical (diff -q clean). Guard wired into doc-gates.yml as a blocking step with push+PR path triggers. Minor @barkpark/react changeset.

Reviewer fix — absorbed the stalled Slice 2 (merge-safety)

Slice 2 (rpu-w7-cba-seed-regen) STALLED: it was dispatched off origin/main before Slice 1 committed, so its generator saw 42 goldens and had nothing to regenerate — it correctly left itself in_progress with an honest stall note. But that left a real cross-slice merge blocker: create-barkpark-app's showcase-content.test.ts does readdirSync(pd-golden) and asserts a hard toHaveLength(42) — so merging Slice 1 alone would RED that gate on main once the pd-golden set is 46. As the last hands before merge, the reviewer absorbed Slice 2's mechanical deliverable into Slice 1's -r branch (commit bd4b045a7): regenerated seeds/showcase-content.ts 42→46 via gen-showcase-content.mjs, bumped the test count guards 42→46, re-synced the cloud vendored mirror (diff -r clean), added a create-barkpark-app patch changeset. Result: ONE branch now merges green and fully closes the WISH.

Gate re-run on the reviewer branch (all green)

  • bash scripts/pd-parity-completeness.sh → "OK: all 46 in-scope", exit 0.
  • CC=clang MIX_ENV=test mix test .../pd_golden_parity_test.exs → 141 tests, 0 failures (46 types × freshness + mirror-identity + scope).
  • pnpm --filter @barkpark/react build ok · test 254 passed (13 files) · size all 4 entries within budget (index 17.49/18 kB, server 16.65/17 kB — tight).
  • pnpm --filter create-barkpark-app test 21 passed · typecheck 0 · cloud mirror diff -r clean.
  • Anti-vacuous re-proven: unregistering the chat-approval emitter reds PortableDoc.parity (1 failed / 62 passed, DOM-shape mismatch); restored → green. The 46 parity assertions are armed, not skipped.

Honesty — what falls short

  • The wave as autonomously BUILT would have redded create-barkpark-app on merge (the Slice-2 sequencing miss). It merges green only because the reviewer absorbed the fix. Not a Slice-1 code defect — a wave-decomposition/sequencing flaw the reviewer phase closed.
  • Cosmetic: Slice 1's criteria text says "45" throughout while ground truth is 46 (the builder documented the delta in every evidence stamp; rpu-backlog-stale-42-prose-sweep tracks the cleanup).
  • Coverage: only gauge-list share-mode is golden-exercised; count/epic paths are code-review-verified but not fixture-pinned. Latent: chat_status_label/1 in Elixir has no catch-all (crashes on an invalid status) while the JS twin returns the raw string — harmless for the normalized statuses real blocks carry, consistent with the documented W1 JS-leniency note.

Ledger audit

Clean. rpu-backlog-completeness-guard-chat-types: in_progress, criteria [met×7, open] — the 8th "PR merged" left for the LEAD — parent portabledoc-blog-epic-goal, wave_paper linked, now-line names the -r merge target. rpu-w7-cba-seed-regen: in_progress, 0/5, now-line records the absorption into Slice 1's -r branch (LEAD closes on merge — no re-dispatch). No out-of-wave tasks touched.

Grade: A−

The core WISH is delivered cleanly, faithfully, and protectively: the canonical renderer covers all 46 in-scope types, byte-shape-equal to Elixir goldens, gate green, revert-red proven. The gauge-list escalation was correctly detected and handled rather than shipping a red gate. The single deduction: the wave did not merge green as built — a stalled downstream slice would have broken another package's CI, requiring the reviewer to complete it.
